# Switch NX2 - Turbo Configuration for Hortensia
# Copy this file as nx2_switches.txt next to hortensia.exe or in %APPDATA%\hortensia\nx2_switches.txt
# to activate all optimizations for Mario Kart World and Switch 2 games.

# Enable GPU split thread (offloads method/macro execution to back thread)
EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=2

# Flush draw call budget (128 draws per batch to balance CPU/GPU load)
EDEN_NX2_FLUSH_DRAWS=128

# Spin budgets for thread synchronization
EDEN_NX2_WAIT_SPINS=256
EDEN_NX2_BACK_SPIN=512

# Per-slot semaphore waiting (avoids unnecessary global waits)
EDEN_NX2_SEM_SLOT_WAIT=1

# Memory peek and queued release optimizations
EDEN_NX2_ACQUIRE_PEEK=1
EDEN_NX2_ACQUIRE_QUEUED=1

# Memory ranges and trusted list fetching (avoids redundant writer drains in MKW)
EDEN_NX2_DMA_RANGES=1
EDEN_NX2_LIST_TRUST=1
EDEN_NX2_CB_COALESCE=1

# Native SSBO sizing: 0 sizes SSBOs by descriptor, eliminating the 7.6 GiB/s GPU readback bug in MKW
EDEN_NX2_NATIVE_SSBO_SIZE=0

# Event-based pending semaphore wake (eliminates 3ms sleep in vi2::Present)
EDEN_NX2_PENDING_WAKE=1

# ASTC texture decoding and transcoding optimizations (SmileyTatsu)
EDEN_NX2_ASTC_ONE_SUBMIT=1
EDEN_NX2_ASTC_SCRATCH_BUCKET=1
EDEN_NX2_ASTC_POOL_V2=1
EDEN_NX2_ASTC_POOL_FIT=1

# Buffer cache usage tracker reset skip for idle buffers
EDEN_NX2_USAGE_RESET_SKIP=1

# AMD GPU parallel pipeline compilation on Windows
EDEN_NX2_AMD_PARALLEL_PIPELINES=1

# Accurate FPS logging every 5s and session summary at shutdown
EDEN_FPS_LOG=1
